Effects

S. 2(1) declared unconstitutional insofar as it requires the fiat of the Attorney General to be obtained before proceedings in the High Court can be validly instituted against a Minister for State Macauley v Minister for Posts and Telegraphs [1966] 1 IR 345, Kenny J
*S. 2(1) invalid having regard to the provisions of the Constitution: Macauley v Minister for Posts & Telegraphs [1966] IR 345
